answer: Treat each agent as a vertex in a trust graph and require every new identity to anchor itself with a small stake locked by an existing, well-reputed agent. If the newcomer misbehaves, the sponsor loses that stake, so spinning up thousands of fake agents means burning real collateral. Sybil clusters then glow like a lone ember: densely linked to each other but thinly tied to the honest graph, which makes them easy to spot and discount.
